title: Positive-edge graph imbalance conjecture
statement: If every edge of a graph joins vertices of different degrees, then the multiset of absolute endpoint-degree differences is graphical.

counterexample.description: A graph in which every edge joins vertices of different degrees, but the multiset \(\{\lvert d(u)-d(v)\rvert:uv\in E\}\) is not graphical. It has been checked through 12 vertices. A different *mean-imbalance* conjecture was disproved in 2023; this positive-edge conjecture remains open.
